dict.Marfa primită înapoi de la clienți: fact: Goods received back from customers: the original invoice, the value with VAT, the reason (including the 14-day withdrawal for online purchases) and what is done with the goods; from the credit invoice and the amount refunded you get the amount still to refund and the status: credit invoice to issue or money to refund (yellow), closed (green), and those unresolved for more than 14 days in red.
dict.Marfa repusă în vânzare intră înapoi în: Goods put back on sale go back into Sheets → Stock card; goods defective from the supplier go to Sheets → Returns to suppliers.
dict.Pentru fiecare retur se emite factura st: For each return a credit invoice (with minus) is issued to the customer; the money is refunded the same way it came in (account, card, cash).
